a.lede: A small number of early adopters of the much-hyped new foldable phone from Apple have complained of screens cracking.
a.title: Uh-oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it

b.lede: Apple's "precision-engineered" hinge is apparently damaging some iPhone Duo screens.
b.title: Some iPhone Duo screens are already failing
